heading.en: Many Nephites migrate to the land northward—They build houses of cement and keep many records—Tens of thousands are converted and baptized—The word of God leads men to salvation—Nephi the son of Helaman fills the judgment seat. About 49–39 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua malaga atu le toatele o sa Nifaē i le laueleele i matu—Ua latou fausia fale sima ma tausia talafaamaumau e tele—Ua faaliliu mai ma papatisoina le sefulu o afe ma afe—O le afioga a le Atua e taitai atu ai tagata i le olataga—Ua nofo Nifae, le atalii o Helamana, i le nofoa-faamasino. E tusa o le 49–39 T.L.M.

verses.en: And now it came to pass in the forty and third year of the reign of the judges, there was no contention among the people of Nephi save it were a little pride which was in the church, which did cause some little dissensions among the people, which affairs were settled in the ending of the forty and third year.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa oo i le lona fasefulu ma le tolu o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino, sa leai ni finauga i totonu o le nuu o Nifae vagana ai sina faamaualuga laitiiti sa i ai i totonu o le ekalesia, lea na mafua mai ai ni faatuiesega itiiti i totonu o le nuu, o ni mataupu sa faaleleia i le faaiuga o le lona fasefulu ma le tolu o tausaga.

verses.en: And there was no contention among the people in the forty and fourth year; neither was there much contention in the forty and fifth year.
verses.sm: Ma sa leai se finauga i totonu o le nuu i le lona fasefulu ma le fa o tausaga; pe sa i ai foi se finauga tele i le lona fasefulu ma le lima o tausaga.

verses.en: And it came to pass in the forty and sixth, yea, there was much contention and many dissensions; in the which there were an exceed– ingly great many who departed out of the land of Zarahemla, and went forth unto the land northward to inherit the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le lona fasefulu ma le ono o tausaga, ioe, sa i ai finauga e tele ma faatuiesega e tele; ia na toatele naua ai e na o ese mai le laueleele o Sara’emila, ma o atu i le laueleele i matu e fai mo o latou tofi le laueleele.

verses.en: And they did travel to an exceedingly great distance, insomuch that they came to large bodies of water and many rivers.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou malaga atu i se mea mamao tele lava, sa oo ina latou tau atu i vaituloto tetele ma vaitafe e tele.

verses.en: Yea, and even they did spread forth into all parts of the land, into whatever parts it had not been rendered desolate and without timber, because of the many inhabitants who had before inherited the land.
verses.sm: Ioe, sa oo ina latou salalau atu i vaega uma o le laueleele, i soo se vaega sa lei faatafunaina ma aunoa ma laau matua, ona o le toatele o tagata o e sa aina muamua ma fai mo latou tofi le laueleele.

w.en: it had not been made desolate

verses.en: And now no part of the land was desolate, save it were for timber; but because of the greatness of the destruction of the people who had before inhabited the land it was called desolate.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa leai se vaega o le laueleele sa faatafunaina, vagana ai laau matua; ae ona o le tele o le faafanoga o tagata o e sa ’ainā muamua le laueleele o lea na ta’ua ai o tafuna.

verses.en: And there being but little timber upon the face of the land, nevertheless the people who went forth became exceedingly expert in the working of cement; therefore they did build houses of cement, in the which they did dwell.
verses.sm: Ma ona sa itiiti laau matua sa i ai i luga o le laueleele, ae ui i lea o tagata o e na o atu i ai sa oo ina atamamai tele i le faaaogaina o le sima; o lea na latou fausia ai fale i le sima, ia na latou nonofo ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did multiply and spread, and did go forth from the land south ward to the land northward, and did spread insomuch that they began to cover the face of the whole earth, from the sea south to the sea north, from the sea west to the sea east.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou uluuluola ma salalau atu, ma o atu mai le laueleele i saute i le laueleele i matu, ma salalau atu sa oo ina amata ona ufitia ia te i latou luga o le fogaeleele atoa, mai le sami i saute i le sami i matu, mai le sami i sisifo i le sami i sasae.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And the people who were in the land northward did dwell in tents, and in houses of cement, and they did suffer whatsoever tree should spring up upon the face of the land that it should grow up, that in time they might have timber to build their houses, yea, their cities, and their temples, and their synagogues, and their sanctuaries, and all manner of their buildings.
verses.sm: Ma o tagata o e sa i le laueleele i matu, sa nonofo i faleie, ma i fale sima, ma sa latou faasao soo se laau e totogo a’e i luga o le laueleele ina ia tupu ae, ina ia latou maua ai i se taimi laupapa e fau ai o latou fale, ioe, o o latou aai, ma o latou malumalu, ma o latou sunako, ma o latou falesa, ma o latou fale o ituaiga eseese uma.

verses.en: And it came to pass as timber was exceedingly scarce in the land northward, they did send forth much by the way of shipping.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo talu ai ona sa tau le maua tele laau matua i le laueleele i matu, o lea sa latou auina atu ai le tele e ala i vaa.

verses.en: And thus they did enable the people in the land northward that they might build many cities, both of wood and of cement.
verses.sm: Ma sa faapea ona latou faia ia mafai ai e tagata i le laueleele i matu ona latou fausia o aai e tele, i laau ma i le sima.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there were many of the people of Ammon, who were Lamanites by birth, did also go forth into this land.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa i ai le toatele o tagata o le nuu o Amona, o e o ni sa Lamanā i lo latou fananau mai, na o atu foi i lenei laueleele.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And now there are many records kept of the proceedings of this people, by many of this people, which are particular and very large, concerning them.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei e tele talafaamaumau na tausia e uiga i le taualumaga a nei tagata, e le toatele o i latou, ia ua faapitoa ma tele naua, e uiga ia te i latou.

verses.en: But behold, a hundredth part of the proceedings of this people, yea, the account of the Lamanites and of the Nephites, and their wars, and contentions, and dissensions, and their preaching, and their prophecies, and their  shipping and their building of ships, and their building of temples, and of synagogues and their sanctuaries, and their righteousness, and their wickedness, and their murders, and their robbings, and their plundering, and all manner of abominations and whoredoms, cannot be contained in this work.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o se tasi vaeselau o taualumaga a nei tagata, ioe, o le tala e uiga ia sa Lamanā ma sa Nifaē, ma a latou taua, ma finauga, ma faatuiesega, ma a latou talaiga, ma a latou valoaga, ma a latou felauaiga i vaa ma lo latou fausiaina o vaa, ma lo latou fausiaina o malumalu, ma sunako ma o latou falesa; ma lo latou amiotonu, ma lo latou amioleaga, ma lo latou fasioti tagata, ma lo latou faomea, ma a latou vetega, ma uiga inosia ma faitaaga eseese uma, e le mafai ona faamauina i lenei galuega.

verses.en: But behold, there are many books and many records of every kind, and they have been kept chiefly by the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ae faauta, e tele tusi o i ai ma talafaamaumau e tele o ituaiga eseese, ma sa tausia faapitoa i latou e tagata sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And they have been handed down from one generation to another by the Nephites, even until they have fallen into transgression and have been murdered, plundered, and hunted, and driven forth, and slain, and scattered upon the face of the earth, and mixed with the Lamanites until they are no more called the Nephites, becoming wicked, and wild, and ferocious, yea, even becoming Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuulima faasolo ifo nei talafaamaumau mai le tasi tupulaga i le isi tupulaga e tagata sa Nifaē, seia oo ina latou pa’u’ū atu i le solitulafono ma sa fasiotia, veteina, ma tuliloaina, ma tutulia, ma fasia, ma faataapeapeina i luga o le fogaeleele, ma fefiloi ma sa Lamanā seia oo ina lē toe ta’ua i latou o ni sa Nifaē, ona ua amioleaga, ma aivao, ma fe’ai, ioe, ua avea ai lava o ni sa Lamanā.

verses.en: And now I return again to mine account; therefore, what I have spoken had passed after there had been great contentions, and disturbances, and wars, and dissensions, among the people of Nephi.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te toe foi atu i la’u tala; o lea, o mea na ou fai atu ai ua tuanai atu ina ua mavae lea ona i ai o finauga tetele, ma faalavelave, ma taua, ma faatuiesega, i totonu o le nuu o Nifae.

verses.en: The forty and sixth year of the reign of the judges ended;
verses.sm: Ua faaiuina le lona fasefulu ma le ono o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino;

verses.en: And it came to pass that there was still great contention in the land, yea, even in the forty and seventh year, and also in the forty and eighth year.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa i ai pea finauga tetele i le laueleele, ioe, e oo lava i le lona fasefulu ma le fitu o tausaga, ma le lona fasefulu ma le valu foi o tausaga.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Nevertheless Helaman did fill the judgment– seat with justice and equity; yea, he did observe to keep the statutes, and the judgments, and the commandments of God; and he did do that which was right in the sight of God continually; and he did walk after the ways of his father, insomuch that he did prosper in the land.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea sa nofo Helamana i le nofoa-faamasino ma le faamasinotonu ma le lē faaitu’au; ioe, sa ia tausisi e tausi tulafono, ma faamasinoga, ma poloaiga a le Atua; ma sa ia faia e le aunoa le mea sa’o i le silafaga a le Atua; ma sa ia savali i ala o lona tamā, sa oo ina manuia o ia i le laueleele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he had two sons. He gave unto the eldest the name of Nephi, and unto the youngest, the name of Lehi. And they began to grow up unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina i ai ia te ia ni atalii se toalua. Sa ia tuu atu i le ulumatua le igoa o Nifae, ma i le laitiiti, le igoa o Liae. Ma sa amata ona laua tutupu ae i le Alii.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass that the wars and contentions began to cease, in a small degree, among the people of the Nephites, in the latter end of the forty and eighth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona taofia o taua ma finauga, i se tulaga itiiti, i totonu o tagata sa Nifaē, i le taufaaiuga o le lona fasefulu ma le valu o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino i le nuu o Nifae.

w.en: Now it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass in the forty and ninth year of the reign of the judges, there was continual peace established in the land, all save it were the secret combinations which Gadianton the robber had established in the more settled parts of the land, which at that time were not known unto those who were at the head of government; therefore they were not destroyed out of the land.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le lona fasefulu ma le iva o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino, sa faaauau pea ona i ai le filemu sa faatuina i le laueleele, i mea uma, vagana ai pulega faalilolilo ia na faatuina e Katianetona le faomea i vaega sili ona aina o le laueleele, ia sa le iloa i le taimi lena e i latou o e sa faauluulu i le malo; o lea sa le faaumatia ai i latou mai le laueleele.

w.en: in the most inhabited parts of

verses.en: And it came to pass that in this same year there was exceedingly great prosperity in the church, insomuch that there were thousands  who did join themselves unto the church and were baptized unto repentance.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i lenei lava tausaga sa i ai le manuia tele naua i le ekalesia, sa oo ina i ai le afe ma afe o e na latou auai i latou lava i le ekalesia, ma sa papatisoina i le salamo.

verses.en: And so great was the prosperity of the church, and so many the blessings which were poured out upon the people, that even the high priests and the teachers were themselves astonished beyond measure.
verses.sm: Ma sa matuā tele naua le manuia o le ekalesia, ma matuā tele naua faamanuiaga na liligi ifo i luga o tagata, e oo i faitaulaga sili ma a’oa’o sa lē mafuatiaina lo latou ofo tele.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the work of the Lord did prosper unto the baptizing and uniting to the church of God, many souls, yea, even tens of thousands.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina manuia lava le galuega a le Alii i le papatisoina ma le faatasia i le ekalesia a le Atua, o agaga e toatele, ioe, e oo lava i le atu sefulu o afe.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: Thus we may see that the Lord is merciful unto all who will, in the sincerity of their hearts, call upon his holy name.
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona mafai ona tatou vaai ai e alofa mutimutivale le Alii ia te i latou uma o e e valaau atu i lona suafa paia, ma le faamaoni o o latou loto.

verses.en: Yea, thus we see that the gate of heaven is open unto all, even to those who will believe on the name of Jesus Christ, who is the Son of God.
verses.sm: Ioe, ua faapea ona tatou vaai ai ua tatala le faitotoa o le lagi i tagata uma, ioe ia i latou lava o e e talitonu i le suafa o Iesu Keriso, o ia o le Alo o le Atua.

verses.en: Yea, we see that whosoever will may lay hold upon the word of God, which is quick and powerful, which shall divide asunder all the cunning and the snares and the wiles of the devil, and lead the man of Christ in a strait and narrow course across that everlasting gulf of misery which is prepared to engulf the wicked—
verses.sm: Ioe, ua tatou vaai e mafai e soo se tasi e manao i ai ona taofimau i le afioga a le Atua, lea ua vave ma malosi, lea o le a veteina ai le poto leaga ma mailei ma fuafuaga uma a le tiapolo, ma ta’ita’i atu ai le tagata o Keriso i le ala lauitiiti ma vaapiapi, i luga atu o le vanu pagatia tumau e faavavau lea ua saunia e faaumatia ai e e amioleaga—

verses.en: And land their souls, yea, their immortal souls, at the right hand of God in the kingdom of heaven, to sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and with Jacob, and with all our holy fathers, to go no more out.
verses.sm: Ma tuuina atu o latou agaga, ioe, o latou agaga ola pea, i le itu taumatau o le Atua i le malo o le lagi, e nonofo faatasi ma Aperaamo, ma Isaako, ma Iakopo, ma faatasi ma o tatou tamā paia uma, e le toe o atu i fafo.

verses.en: And in this year there was continual rejoicing in the land of Zarahemla, and in all the regions round about, even in all the land which was possessed by the Nephites.
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai i lenei tausaga olioliga faifai pea i le laueleele o Sara’emila, ma nofoaga uma o faataamilo ai, e oo lava i le laueleele atoa lea sa maua e sa Nifaē.

verses.en: And it came to pass that there was peace and exceedingly great joy in the remainder of the forty and ninth year; yea, and also there was continual peace and great joy in the fiftieth year of the reign of the judges.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina i ai le filemu ma le olioli tele naua i le vaega na totoe o le lona fasefulu ma le iva o tausaga; ioe, ma sa i ai foi le filemu ma le olioli tele faifai pea i le lona limasefulu o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And in the fifty and first year of the reign of the judges there was peace also, save it were the pride which began to enter into the church—not into the church of God, but into the hearts of the people who professed to belong to the church of God—
verses.sm: Ma sa i ai foi le filemu i le lona limasefulu ma le tasi o tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino, vagana ai le faamaualuga lea na amata ona ulu mai i totonu o le ekalesia— e le o le ekalesia a le Atua, ae i totonu o loto o tagata o e na fai mai ua latou auai i le ekalesia a le Atua—

verses.en: And they were lifted up in pride, even to the persecution of many of their brethren. Now this was a great evil, which did cause the more humble part of the people to suffer great persecutions, and to wade through much affliction.
verses.sm: Ma sa faafefeteina i latou i le faamaualuga, e oo lava i le latou sauaina o le toatele o o latou uso. O lenei o se mea leaga tele lenei mea, lea na mafua ai ona mafatia o le toatele o le vaega sili ona lotomaualalalo o tagata i sauaga tetele, ma latou asa atu ai i puapuaga e tele.

verses.en: Nevertheless they did fast and pray oft, and did wax stronger and stronger in their humility, and firmer and firmer in the faith of Christ, unto the filling their souls with joy and consolation, yea, even to the purifying and the sanctification of their hearts, which sanctification cometh because of their yielding their hearts unto God.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, sa latou anapopogi ma tatalo pea lava pea, ma sa faasolo malolosi ma faatupulaia ai pea i lo latou lotomaualalalo, ma mausali ma atili mausali ai i le faatuatua ia Keriso, seia oo ina faatutumuina o latou agaga i le olioli ma le faamafanafanaga, ioe, seia oo ina faamamāina ma faapaiaina o latou loto, o le faapaiaga lea e oo mai ona o lo latou tuuina atu o o latou loto i le Atua.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the fifty and second year ended in peace also, save it were the exceedingly great pride which had gotten into the hearts of the people; and it was because of their exceedingly great riches and their prosperity in the land; and it did grow upon them from day to day.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faaiuina foi le lona limasefulu ma le lua o tausaga i le filemu, vagana ai le faamaualuga tele lea ua ulu i totonu o loto o tagata; ma o le pogai ona o a latou oa ua tele naua ma lo latou manuia i luga o le laueleele; ma sa tupu ae i luga o i latou mai lea aso i lea aso.

w.en: And it came to pass that

verses.en: And it came to pass in the fifty and third year of the reign of the judges, Helaman died, and his eldest son Nephi began to reign in his stead. And it came to pass that he did fill the judgment– seat with justice and equity; yea, he did keep the commandments of God, and did walk in the ways of his father.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo i le lona limasefulu ma le tolu tausaga o le nofoaiga a faamasino, ua maliu Helamana, ma sa amata ona nofoia e lona atalii matua o Nifae e suitulaga ia te ia. Ma sa oo ina tauave e ia le nofoa-faamasino ma le faamasinotonu ma le lē faaitu’au; ioe, sa ia tausi poloaiga a le Atua, ma sa savali o ia i ala o lona tamā.

w.en: And it came to pass that
